items.item:
2. After a release without a type, its pointers are still listed by 'list
   artifacts' with their statuses.
   Shows A22-2. [witness: verification:registry_a22_removed_type_pointers_still_listed]
statements:
```text
declared_types(first release) = {estimate -> PresuPro}   -- A22-1
pointers are never removed or rewritten by a vocabulary change   -- A22-2
publish(t) or latest(t) with t not declared => unknown type   -- A22-3
```

verdicts.why: The selected test asserts A22-2 by preserving the removed type’s pointers, statuses, projection, and unchanged store rows, and it exercises A22-3 for publishing and reading latest after removal through the refusal helper. It does not establish A22-1’s exact first-release declaration mapping—particularly that estimate is the only declared type and maps to PresuPro—so it does not assert every named invariant.
